scope: Native local/server pause, warp, canonical relaunch, focus/suspend release and existing performance-budget publication. Bevy retirement remains incomplete.

contract.authority: Existing FlightAuthority or embedded server; no independently advanced client simulation clock, solver-dt changes or local server fallback.
contract.controls: --flight/--server-flight plus --paused / --warp 0..131072. F8 pause; brackets half/double (key minimum 0.125, CLI/HUD allow x0); Backspace relaunch without rewinding. HUD keeps requested state separate from authoritative pause/effective warp. Arrow keys retain camera behavior; Space retains engine toggle. A valid authoritative stop retains the live link for Reset; transport/protocol failures still close it. Reset events share the existing queue bound, reserving two clock votes and rejecting overflow without mutating queued events.
contract.focus: Clear held stick/throttle keys and pointer gestures on focus loss/suspend; apply/send neutral axes without altering retained throttle/engine demand. Reset elapsed window baseline, never catch up missing wall time.
contract.capture: Local SimBudget reports existing steps/rails/debt and actual frame-wall effective rate. Headless --flight-step is deterministic admission demand, not frame wall time. Server captures report server effective warp and zero local solver work. Simulation CPU attribution remains unmeasured.

verification.status: all fourteen final local gates passed on unchanged compiled sources; earlier native-flight-clock-stable run is diagnostic because sources changed during it

window_smoke.boundary: Wayland/compositor and default graphics included, not game FPS, input-injection acceptance or independent visual review

real_server_final.boundary: pause/relaunch/resume acknowledgement, not sustained x4 throughput

targeted_evidence.native_cpu: cargo test -p thessa-terrain-native --bin thessa-terrain-native: 51 passed at the targeted run; four added clock/focus/acknowledgement/relaunch regressions.
targeted_evidence.real_server: cargo build -p thessa-server; cargo test -p thessa-terrain-native --bin thessa-terrain-native real_server_adoption -- --ignored --nocapture --test-threads=1: passed. Receives geometry/appearance, acknowledges pause, resets while paused without rewinding, resumes with x4 demand and retains zero local steps/debt.
targeted_evidence.headless: cargo test --release -p thessa-terrain-native --test perf_capture headless_flight_time -- --ignored --nocapture --test-threads=1: passed on Radeon 880M/Vulkan. At --warp 2 --flight-step 0.025 each measured unpaused frame advances six 1/120s steps; 30 warmup + two measured frames reach 1.6s. Paused run reaches 0s with zero steps. Captured rate is actual advanced seconds / measured frame wall, within 1e-10 arithmetic tolerance.
targeted_evidence.fixed_step_limit: At x131072 with an exhausted (zero-duration) local work budget, one mandatory fixed step advances and unserved whole-tick debt is shed; no requested-time teleport or solver-step inflation.
targeted_evidence.hardware: AMD Radeon 880M / RADV STRIX1 / Vulkan; no Metal/WebGPU execution or independent visual acceptance. No output audio device used by fixtures.
